events.title: ☕️ Coffee Talk
events.venue: Iffy Books, 404 S. 20th St., Philadelphia, 19146, United States
events.description: A social hangout every first and third Monday for trans and non-binary people, their significant others, and allies. We have snacks and coffee.

events.title: ✏️ The Writing Room
events.venue: Iffy Books, 404 S. 20th St., Philadelphia, 19146, United States
events.description: Come co-work with other writers in three 40-minute units of silent writing. Writers and projects of any type welcome. 10-minute breaks and accountability check-ins between units. BYO coffee, water, computer chargers, notepads, etc.

events.title: 📼 Analog A/V Session
events.venue: Iffy Books, 404 S. 20th St., Philadelphia, 19146, United States
events.description: Come experiment with VHS tapes and audio cassettes! We'll have equipment on hand for analog-to-digital and digital-to-analog transfers.

events.title: 🔊 DJ Basixxx with Mixxx
events.venue: Iffy Books, 404 S. 20th St., Philadelphia, 19146, United States
events.description: If you're curious about DJing but don't have money to drop on equipment, this workshop is for you! You'll learn to use Mixxx, a free and open source DJ program for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

events.title: 🔋 Beginner Soldering: Li-Ion Battery Pack
events.venue: Iffy Books, 404 S. 20th St., Philadelphia, 19146, United States
events.description: Make a rechargeable battery pack for your LoRa node, a microcontroller such as an ESP32 or Pi Pico, or anything that runs on 3–4 Volts. Perfect for folks who've never soldered before!

events.title: ⚡️ Beginner Soldering: LED Spinning Top
events.venue: Iffy Books, 404 S. 20th St., Philadelphia, 19146, United States
events.description: For this class we're building a spinning top toy with LED lights that flash when it spins. No previous soldering experience required!

events.title: 💻 Philly 2600 Meetup
events.venue: Iffy Books, 404 S. 20th St., Philadelphia, 19146, United States
events.description: The Philly 2600 meeting is a monthly gathering of local hackers, phreaks, nerds, geeks, activists, tinkerers, developers, infosec professionals, and other interesting people.

events.title: 🧵 Anarchist Sewing Club
events.venue: Iffy Books, 404 S. 20th St., Philadelphia, 19146, United States
events.description: Interested in learning to sew, mend or make clothes? Already know how and wanna hang out with people while sewing? Come and join us! Sewing supplies and a sewing machine will be available for anyone needing them.

events.title: 🏴 Anarchy Summer Reading Group: 'The Utopia of Rules' by David Graeber (2nd half)
events.venue: Iffy Books, 404 S. 20th St., Philadelphia, 19146, United States
events.description: We're meeting every two weeks to discuss classics of anarchist literature, starting with Anarchism and Other Essays by Emma Goldman and The Conquest of Bread by Peter Kropotkin.
